title: FlowFix Revision Planner Output
description: Schema for the revision-planner flow output. Consumer must validate before presenting to student or applying any changes. All proposed changes require explicit student approval. Backend must verify submission_id and submission_version match the current state before applying.

submission_id.description: Echoed from current_submission. Used by backend to match the revision plan to the correct submission.

submission_version.description: Echoed from current_submission. Backend must reject this plan if the submission has been updated since this version.

root_cause.description: Explanation of why the reviewer flagged this issue.

current_value.description: Current value of the field in the submission.

proposed_value.description: Proposed corrected value, based on evidence.

evidence.description: Quoted text from the evidence document supporting the proposed value.

evidence_source.description: Filename of the document used as evidence.

evidence_used.description: List of filenames of documents used as evidence for the proposed changes.

needs_human_review.description: true if the situation cannot be resolved by the student alone and requires human reviewer intervention.
